checks.detail: The focused release review verified the camera repair, ordinary controls, automatic combat, weapon identities, upgrade transaction, wave fixtures, lifecycle isolation, authored cemetery, shell states, and current logs. Release remains blocked by the unresolved Warden animation defect and absent native-renderer dense qualification; the bounded continuity patrol found no separate durable boundary defect.

A clean physical W then Space route exercised anticipation, active dash, recovery, cooldown, pause/resume, and Retry. The shipped-camera endpoint retained the complete textured Warden, lantern, nearby danger, and an escape lane; nine private-pass visuals were isolated while the primary camera excluded that layer, then all original presentation state was restored after release and Retry.

Ordinary unpaused movement allowed automatic attacks to advance through cooldown_ready, deterministic target_selected, authorized onset, impact, hit, damage, hurt, death, and reward receipts without manual-fire input, freed-target hits, or duplicate runtime errors.

The representative setup exercised all four ordinary roles with nonzero counts, validated capped live occupancy, approach and telegraph behavior, deaths and production pickups. Three resets returned every live enemy, boss, projectile, pickup, effect, neighbor registration, and attack ledger to the same zero-live baseline.

A collected reward advanced authoritative experience, and the paused three-card draft presented truthful authored cards. Holding ordinary Space selected exactly once, changed Warden Lantern from rank 1 to rank 2 with damage 26 to 34 and range 11.5 to 13, dismissed the draft, and resumed gameplay without a duplicate selection.

Gameplay and dense-wave frames showed authoritative health, experience, level, wave, timer, weapon, dash, and boss fields using the product Montserrat hierarchy and authored iconography without debug panels, default-theme controls, clipping, or an arena-obscuring opaque page.

Ordinary title, gameplay, pause, resume, failure, Retry, and three separated profile prepare/advance/reset cycles retained correct input ownership and increasing generations. Immediate and next-frame reset receipts consistently reported zero live actors, projectiles, pickups, effects, wisps, ledgers, neighbors, voices, and stale pause ownership.

Fresh Tester-owned project identity, changed-source inspection, scene bounds, runtime digests, ordinary physical input, distributed framebuffer captures, editor and runtime logs, and final renderer identification were collected against candidate loop-15-484fa5e7776d.

Focused Lantern bolts, Gravespade sweeps, and four orbiting wisps were simultaneously equipped and exercised. Receipts showed distinct target selection, cadence, geometry, hit policy, counters, and visual output, while the upgrade transaction produced an authoritative Lantern build consequence.

The data and runtime exposed five ordered wave ids, escalating role composition, capped elite pressure, the Bellkeeper state and boss bar, terminal wave 5 of 5, exactly-once victory, and stopped post-terminal direction. Fixture evidence supplements rather than claims ordinary end-to-end reachability.

Runtime and editor views showed one bounded high-angle cemetery with intact mausoleum, keeper post, cracked-bell composition, fences, graves, warm lantern accents, cool moonlight, grounded routes, and readable escape lanes. It is sparser than the directional reference but retains its scale, landmark, exposure, and camera language; the documented intact-package mesh qualification was not contradicted by a rendered defect.

Lighting, bounded effects, and semantic audio ownership remained stable with clean runtime logs, but the required Warden animation is not authored skeletal motion: all seven mappings animate wrapper pivots around a static mesh, and failure teardown resets death to idle before Retry.

Title, pause, draft, failure, victory, result, Retry, and return transitions occupied the full viewport with authored typography and iconography, truthful summaries, coherent physical Space/Escape focus ownership, and no observed input leak or clipped control at the tested default scale.

Three 1920x1080 cycles each prepared 32 ordinary enemies with all four roles, Bellkeeper, all weapons, pickups, HUD, effects, lights, and audio, then reset with exact immediate and next-frame isolation. Recorded p95 values were 149.475, 144.444, and 145.885 ms, but the renderer was Mesa llvmpipe, so these timings cannot qualify or condemn native player performance. coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.fps_runtime_stutter.6b972c8aebe3=insufficient_evidence;

Failure and victory results, three weapon families, build summaries, statistics, Retry, and terminal cleanup were observed, but the unresolved Warden animation defect, unavailable native performance qualification, and absence of one continuous ordinary seven-to-ten-minute completion receipt prevent release acceptance.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime evidence against the PRD requirements for phase release_convergence.

Use ordinary keyboard and gamepad-equivalent input to verify camera-relative planar movement, collision sliding, visual facing, dash anticipation/invulnerability/recovery/cooldown, high-angle camera framing and clean pause/resume. Judge only behavior introduced by the active phase; reject hidden threats, contradictory velocity, stuck input or camera modes that drift toward FPS/TPS play.

Bind one stable event chain from cooldown and deterministic legal target selection through emitted attack, hit policy, damage, hurt, exactly-once death and drop. Require visible and audible anticipation, onset, impact and recovery without manual-fire drift, duplicate damage, freed targets, inert attacks or presentation disconnected from state.

Exercise active enemy roles from validated off-camera spawn through approach, separation, telegraph, attack, hurt, death, drop and pool return. Reject collision or out-of-bounds spawns, root sliding, static poses, first-frame damage, unreadable overlap, dead actors moving, permanent clumps, blocked escape lanes and stale pooled state.

Verify enemy reward, collection, experience threshold and overflow, one paused three-choice draft, debounced selection, authoritative build mutation and resumed play with an observable changed attack or utility. Reject duplicate drafts, held-confirm double choice, blank/inert cards, false values, lost overflow or gameplay clocks advancing under draft.

Require every introduced health, experience, level, wave/run, weapon, dash and boss field to match authoritative runtime state while leaving the arena readable. Judge native, fullscreen and supported UI scales; reject default fonts, debug labels, text piles, opaque blue/purple blocks, generic rounded cards, clipped controls and top-left-only pages.

From title through gameplay, pause, player failure and retry, verify single authoritative run transitions and a clean baseline after three restarts. Reject stale actors, timers, signals, pools, pause reasons, input ownership, attacks, effects or audio, and any state that requires restarting the application to recover.

Bind black-box ordinary play and white-box authoritative snapshots, events, transforms, animation/audio owners, logs and distributed frames to the exact candidate. Deterministic setup may reach legal branches, but normal runtime systems and input must cause the accepted outcome.

Exercise every weapon and representative upgrade path. Require focused bolts, close sweep and orbiting area control to retain distinct targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback and build consequences rather than renamed copies of one projectile.

Verify five data-driven wave states, composition escalation, elite pressure and the Bellkeeper's two phases, telegraphs, summons or lane pressure, recovery window, exactly-once defeat and victory. The director must honor live caps and stop after terminal state.

Compare ordinary runtime views with the frozen Mournlight visual reference. Require one coherent bounded cemetery, grounded collision, keeper post, mausoleum and cracked bell landmarks, clear escape lanes, readable silhouettes, coherent scale/materials and no visible stand-ins.

Inspect accepted component/source values and every active animation state, moonlight/lantern hierarchy, causal bounded VFX and semantic audio layer under real crowd density. Reject unrelated fallback clips, sliding/dead movement, overdark or clipped light, leaked loops, hum, unexpected speech, generic tones and effects that hide telegraphs.

Navigate title, settings, upgrade, pause, death, victory and result pages across the full viewport with mouse, keyboard and gamepad focus. Verify persisted audio/window/UI-scale/effect settings, authored iconography and typography, truthful summaries and clean replay/title flow.

Profile the representative final wave and boss at 1920x1080 with 25-40 ordinary enemies, all weapon families, pickups, animation, VFX, lights, UI and audio. Require stable frame-time distribution, bounded high-churn work and no growth across three complete retries.

Play the complete seven-to-ten-minute title-to-result run, including failure and victory branches, three viable build shapes, statistics, credits/provenance and replay. Reject placeholders, debug presentation, missing required content or unresolved release-relevant regressions.
